Select metabolism records for enzyme UGT1A9. Join metabolism to compound records on substrate record ID to retrieve substrate compound names. Join compound structures on molecule registry number to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion, pathway key, organism, enzyme name, and canonical SMILES. Sort by canonical SMILES, substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion, pathway key, organism, and enzyme name. Limit to 200 rows.
